Title: Cookies Policy
Content:  Introduction: At Aseel Capital Company, we are dedicated to protecting the privacy and security of our users. This Cookies Policy outlines how we utilize cookies to collect data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and relevant regulations. • The purpose of this policy is to help you understand how cookies are employed on our website or application and to provide you with options to customize your settings according to your preferences. What Are Cookies? Cookies are small files that are saved on your device when you visit our website. They are used to store and retrieve information about your interactions with the site, which helps us to: • Enhance your user experience. Personalize services to match your preferences. Improve the performance of the website and its services. Types of Cookies We Use: Our website uses several types of cookies, which are categorized as follows: • Essential Cookies:These cookies are necessary for the proper functioning of the website. They cannot be disabled, as they ensure basic functionalities such as logging in and navigating between pages. Essential cookies do not store any personal information. Advertising Cookies:These cookies allow us to display personalized advertisements based on your interests and behavior on our website. They also help improve the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns. Performance Cookies:These cookies analyze traffic and its sources. They allow us to measure and enhance the website’s performance, ensuring a better user experience. Social Media Cookies:These cookies enable you to share content directly on social media platforms. Functional Cookies:These cookies provide additional features and improve the user experience, such as saving language preferences or settings for future visits. Managing Cookies Consent: When you visit our website or application for the first time, a window will appear asking for your consent to use cookies. Please note that essential cookies do not require your consent. You can manage your preferences or adjust your cookie settings at any time through the Cookie Management page available on our website. Withdrawing or Modifying Your Consent: If you want to withdraw or modify your consent for the use of cookies, you can do this in two ways: • Cookie Settings:You can adjust your preferences by changing the allowed categories or turning off non-essential cookies. Contact Us:You can also contact us via email at [privacy@investaseel.sa](mailto:privacy@investaseel.sa). Cookie as per the Cookies Policy: We use a specific cookie to implement our Cookie Policy, which stores your preferences regarding the use of cookies, including: • The extent of your consent. The duration of your consent's validity. Your choices for various types of cookies. Storage of Personal Data: Personal data is used only for the purposes outlined above. Cookies are automatically deleted once they have fulfilled their purpose or upon expiration. Personal data is stored for a duration that complies with the requirements of the Capital Market Authority and is deleted at the end of this specified period. Deletion of Personal Data: Personal data is deleted upon expiration in accordance with the requirements set by the Capital Market Authority (CMA). When data is deleted, Aseel Capital employs technical solutions to ensure that it cannot be recovered or accessed afterward, in compliance with the regulations of the Capital Market Authority (CMA). Privacy Policy: This Cookies Policy is an essential part of Aseel Capital's Privacy Policy. For more information about our privacy practices, please visit the Privacy Policy page on our website.
